assistant.title: e-BIS Sahayak Assistant
assistant.subtitle: Source-Grounded Multilingual Assistant for Indian Standards & BIS Services
assistant.welcome_message:
**Namaste! I am e-BIS Sahayak (ई-बीआईएस सहायक).**

I am your source-grounded intelligent assistant for Indian Standards (IS), mandatory Quality Control Orders (QCOs), and BIS certification schemes (ISI, CRS, FMCS, Hallmarking).

You can ask questions in **English**, **हिन्दी (Hindi)**, or **தமிழ் (Tamil)**. Every answer is verified and cited directly from indexed BIS knowledge documents.
assistant.input_placeholder: Type your query in English, हिन्दी, or தமிழ்...
assistant.insufficient_evidence_desc: The indexed BIS knowledge base did not return authoritative clauses for this specific question. e-BIS Sahayak strictly avoids speculation.
assistant.evidence_guarantee: Evidence-First Guarantee: Every response is bounded by verified standards retrieval. The model is forbidden from inventing clauses or standards.
assistant.loading_rag: Finding relevant BIS standards & preparing verified response...
assistant.click_inspect_prompt: Ask a question or click any citation pill to inspect verbatim grounded source clauses here.

about.hero_title: Intelligent Guidance for Indian Standards & BIS Services
about.hero_desc: e-BIS Sahayak is an intelligent information assistant designed to help manufacturers, businesses, consumers, and researchers navigate Indian Standards (IS), conformity assessment schemes, and testing laboratory networks with confidence.
about.what_subtitle: Bridging the gap between technical standard publications and real-world compliance.
about.feature_1_desc: Instant search and clause-by-clause inspection across electrotechnical, electronics, IT, food, civil, and mechanical standards with mandatory QCO notifications.
about.feature_2_desc: Step-by-step guidance for Scheme-I (ISI Mark), Scheme-II (Compulsory Registration Scheme - CRS), and FMCS for foreign manufacturers with document checklists and fee structures.
about.feature_3_desc: Discover recognized testing facilities across India categorized by state, accreditation scope, and specific Indian Standard testing capabilities.
about.who_subtitle: Built for diverse stakeholders in the Indian quality ecosystem.
about.who_1_desc: Identify mandatory Quality Control Orders (QCOs), testing parameters, and compliance pathways for domestic production.
about.who_2_desc: Navigate CRS registration requirements for electronic goods and FMCS requirements for foreign manufacturing facilities.
about.who_3_desc: Understand standard safety marks, verify product authenticity, and learn about national safety specifications.
about.who_4_desc: Inspect test clauses, environmental ratings, and testing scopes across recognized national facilities.
about.trust_subtitle: How we ensure verifiable answers without speculation.
about.pillar_1_desc: Every response is bounded by verified BIS source documents. Users can click citation pills to inspect verbatim clauses, section numbers, and page numbers.
about.pillar_2_desc: If a query lacks authoritative evidence in the indexed knowledge base, the assistant explicitly states the limitation rather than fabricating ungrounded specifications.
about.pillar_3_desc: Full native support for English, हिन्दी (Hindi), and தமிழ் (Tamil) across the user interface, standards catalogue, and conversational assistant.
about.disclaimer_body: e-BIS Sahayak is an informational assistant developed to assist stakeholders in understanding Indian Standards and BIS conformity pathways. While all information is grounded in official BIS publications, this application does not constitute legal certification, statutory authorization, or formal approval. Manufacturers and applicants must complete their formal licensing, application submissions, and fee payments through the official e-BIS / ManakOnline portal (manakonline.in).

footer.tagline: Your intelligent assistant for Indian Standards, BIS certification guidance, and testing laboratory discovery. Grounded in authoritative BIS documentation.
footer.disclaimer_note: For formal licensing and fee payments, visit the official ManakOnline portal.
